description: Ground-truth labels for the sample RFQ emails. Used to evaluate the extraction and review pipeline against expected classification/verdict, not as pipeline input.

emails.notes: 5 line items, all unambiguous catalog matches, delivery address + date given
6 line items across Schuetze and Kabelkanal, informal tone
customer reference number RFQ 2026-0817 present, formal Sie-Anrede
casual tone, one item has a parenthetical customization note that should land in ExtractedLineItem.notes
KK-4003 requested in meters ('40 Meter') but sold as 2m rods (Stk) -- unit conversion, not identity ambiguity; still flag for review of quantity math
numbered list format, asks about alternative products as a side remark (should not block matching)
customer supplies own article numbers (SC-3003, SC-3004) directly matching catalog
large quantities, split delivery dates, tests handling of two delivery milestones
urgency language ('Anlage steht still'), should surface in additional_notes
quantities given per-filiale with an explicit x3 multiplier instruction -- tests arithmetic, not identity
terse bullet list, no greeting, delivery/billing address inline in signature
largest clean email, mixes all four product families, tests full-catalog coverage

delivery complaint (Reklamation) about a past order, not a new quote request
unsolicited job application (Bewerbung), no product content at all
